title: Palmer again

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You followed?

nodes.speaker: Palmer
nodes.text: Yeah, well you'd be paranoid if your face was stuck on every wall from here to Sang-Ha.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, well you'd be paranoid if your face was stuck on every wall from here to Sang-Ha.
Meridian? Midnight? You sure?

nodes.speaker: Palmer
nodes.text: Fucking Shima. Something about that seem wrong to you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fucking Shima. Something about that seem wrong to you?
Him? Ha! No. But ...

nodes.speaker: Palmer
nodes.text: And do what instead, stay here and join the rats? Become one with the sentient mold? No, I gotta get outta here and I gotta do it soon.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And do what instead, stay here and join the rats? Become one with the sentient mold? No, I gotta get outta here and I gotta do it soon.

nodes.speaker: Palmer
nodes.text: Guess you’re right. Meridian Market. If you’ve fucked me on this…

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Guess you’re right. Meridian Market. If you’ve fucked me on this…

nodes.speaker: Palmer
nodes.text: You’re a piece of work. Now get outta here before someone sees.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You’re a piece of work. Now get outta here before someone sees.

nodes.speaker: Palmer
nodes.text: Who? The fugitive fairy? The Ascenders are down, nothing’s going in or out of the Port… anyway, what do you care?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Who? The fugitive fairy? The Ascenders are down, nothing’s going in or out of the Port… anyway, what do you care?

nodes.speaker: Palmer
nodes.text: Hey, I didn't know you were a subscriber to "I'm a Mercenary Shitbag Monthly".

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, I didn't know you were a subscriber to "I'm a Mercenary Shitbag Monthly".

nodes.speaker: Palmer
nodes.text: Ha. Alright, there’s a dropbox in Helix. Your automata will know where. If you get me outta this, I’ll make sure there's something there for you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ha. Alright, there’s a dropbox in Helix. Your automata will know where. If you get me outta this, I’ll make sure there's something there for you.

nodes.speaker: Palmer
nodes.text: Now that would be telling. So come on, make with the assistance.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Now that would be telling. So come on, make with the assistance.

nodes.speaker: Palmer
nodes.text: You know someone mad enough to risk their neck getting a person like me outta the LUZ on the tracks?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know someone mad enough to risk their neck getting a person like me outta the LUZ on the tracks?

nodes.speaker: Palmer
nodes.text: You know someone mad enough to risk their neck getting a person like me outta the LUZ with a boat?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know someone mad enough to risk their neck getting a person like me outta the LUZ with a boat?

nodes.speaker: Palmer
nodes.text: Alright, fixer. You get me a ride and I’ll owe ya. Cross my eye and hope to die.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright, fixer. You get me a ride and I’ll owe ya. Cross my eye and hope to die.

nodes.speaker: Palmer
nodes.text: He owes me one. Only thing is, Shima ain't a man who likes to be in people’s debt. He might be paying me off with my own blood.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He owes me one. Only thing is, Shima ain't a man who likes to be in people’s debt. He might be paying me off with my own blood.

nodes.speaker: Palmer
nodes.text: He is. As sure as I'm still hungry.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He is. As sure as I'm still hungry.

nodes.speaker: Palmer
nodes.text: Give it a few days, then go check it. If I get outta this alive, I’ll leave something for you. No one can say I don't pay my debts.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Give it a few days, then go check it. If I get outta this alive, I’ll leave something for you. No one can say I don't pay my debts.

nodes.speaker: Palmer
nodes.text: Alright, alright. Hey you get me any food? Not much longer until those drones will spot me for the noises my stomach makes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright, alright. Hey you get me any food? Not much longer until those drones will spot me for the noises my stomach makes.

Oh! You're my savior.

*eating*
*eating* You deliver the message?

nodes.speaker: Palmer
nodes.text: Yeah well forget to wake up tomorrow. Do everyone a favor. You deliver the message?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah well forget to wake up tomorrow. Do everyone a favor. You deliver the message?
Don't think so.
You're being paranoid.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes. He said to be at Meridian Market, at midnight.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. He said to be at Meridian Market, at midnight.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yes. He said to be at Meridian Market, at midnight.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yes. He said to be at Meridian Market, at midnight.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That’s what he said.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It does seem a bit exposed for a secret meet.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It does seem a bit exposed for a secret meet.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It does seem a bit exposed for a secret meet.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It does seem a bit exposed for a secret meet.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don't you trust him?
So don't go.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Seems like you don't have much choice.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Seems like you don't have much choice.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Seems like you don't have much choice.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Seems like you don't have much choice.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I haven't.
If you say so.
Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Could someone else get you out?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Could someone else get you out?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Could someone else get you out?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Could someone else get you out?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I want to help.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll help you, for a fee.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll help you, for a fee.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'll help you, for a fee.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'll help you, for a fee.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Takes one to know one.
What?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I know people on the tracks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know people on the tracks.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I know people on the tracks.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I know people on the tracks.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I know people at the Docks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know people at the Docks.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I know people at the Docks.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I know people at the Docks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think so.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Besides him being his usual self?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Besides him being his usual self?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Besides him being his usual self?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Besides him being his usual self?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If it's empty I'll find you..

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If it's empty I'll find you..
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If it's empty I'll find you..
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If it's empty I'll find you..

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have some bread.
How about an apple?
Do you fancy an orange?
Sorry, didn't find the time.
I believe so.

Conditions are preserved, not evaluated; route totals are conditional on them.
Only literal assignments and increments are interpreted; other scripts stay unparsed.
Demeanor is an NPC expression, not a relationship-meter change.
Friend/Business icon meanings come from gameplay; Enemy's UI label is unconfirmed.
Routes stop at this conversation's exit; external dialogue gates are shown separately.
